what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee approved the personnel action form to hire a new Director of Public Works, by roll call.
The new director is placed at step five of grade 16, a placement the HR representative tied to civil engineering experience.
The new director is expected to start on the 9th, so the post will not be vacant, and staff were briefed on the chain of command in the interim.
The committee approved the September 28, 2020 minutes by roll call before taking up the hire.

why_it_matters: The Director of Public Works leads a department that handles roads and other public services, and the step placement sets the pay for that post in the town budget, mostly taxes.
